outcome: postpartum complications (wound complication, fever, abdominal pain, headache/dizziness, breast problem, hypertension)
cohort: Women who made at least one visit to the emergency department within 42 days after delivery at a tertiary care women's hospital over a 6-month period.
finding: Women presenting to the emergency department postpartum had a wide variety of medical issues, but 78% of these visits did not result in hospital admission.
mod_finding: Fifty-seven percent of the emergency department visits were made by women who had delivered vaginally.
